lead.claim: Prioritize short-foot exercise in early ACLR rehab for better hip control.
lead.context: Why this matters: This exploratory RCT compared short-foot and toe-curl exercises in ACLR patients, observing hip adduction during single-leg landing.

supporting.claim: Use the Stair Test or Step Test to monitor mobility in MS patients.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study evaluated the reliability and validity of the Stair Test and Step Test for monitoring mobility in individuals with multiple sclerosis.

supporting.claim: Personalize BCI parameters for stroke patients; MI timing may not matter.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This single-case design study explored individual learning trajectories and the effect of motor imagery timing in network-based BCI rehabilitation for stroke patients.

supporting.claim: Protein-enriched diets may not improve early recovery from fragility fractures.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This RCT investigated if a protein-enriched diet during acute hospital stays improved recovery in older adults with fragility fractures.*

supporting.claim: Use the 5STS test to assess muscle strength and readmission risk in severe COPD exacerbation.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study validated the five-repetition sit-to-stand (5STS) test for patients with severe COPD exacerbation, exploring its prognostic value for readmission risk.
